counting_rules.parser: Python regex scanning of CREATE/DROP statements across all migration SQL files
counting_rules.limitation: Raw declaration counts. Does not account for cumulative replacements (CREATE OR REPLACE overwrites without DROP). A local Supabase schema build is required to establish definitive final-state counts.
counting_rules.generated_types_note: lib/supabase/database.types.ts does not exist in this repository. No generated type definitions are available for cross-reference.

tables.note: No DROP TABLE statements found. All 139 declared tables are expected to exist, but this is not proven without a schema build.

rls_policies.note: 74 DROP POLICY statements exist. Many policies are dropped and replaced. Final count requires cumulative analysis.

functions_rpcs.note: CREATE OR REPLACE counts as a creation. Same function may be redefined multiple times. Final unique function count requires signature analysis.

triggers.note: 16 DROP TRIGGER statements exist. Some triggers are dropped and recreated. Discovery report said 66 but inventory regex found 69; difference is due to improved regex including CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER.

indexes.note: 4 DROP INDEX statements exist. Some indexes are dropped. Discovery report said 401 but inventory regex found 385; minor regex sensitivity differences.
